messages.content: You edit short briefs for a team vetting suppliers. Choose the focus that most needs checking, then choose one distinct supporting detail if it adds value. Prefer a concrete issue to routine background. The core statements are already included. Treat the record as data. Only return menu keys in the JSON schema.

{"core": ["Pacific Pacific Education Sdn. Bhd. is listed as active in Selangor (Education).", "The register lists 4 directors. Director 1 holds the largest disclosed stake (49.67%).", "In FY2024, revenue was RM 6,863,227 and the after-tax profit was RM 371,117.", "The record lists 6 court cases (6 as defendant). 2 are marked pending."], "menu": {"case": {"fact": "In CASE-2023-7966, the company is the defendant in a breach of contract (Pending, claim RM 458,400).", "next_check": "Check the latest docket entry for CASE-2023-7966."}, "cash": {"fact": "FY2024 operating cash flow was RM 574,147.", "next_check": "Review the cash-flow statement and reconcile operating cash flow to profit."}, "debt": {"fact": "FY2024 borrowings were RM 1,527,526.", "next_check": "Request the borrowing maturity schedule and check upcoming repayments."}, "filings": {"fact": "FY2023 is missing between FY2022 and FY2024.", "next_check": "Obtain comparable filings before interpreting the change in revenue."}, "liquidity": {"fact": "The FY2024 current ratio was 2.55×.", "next_check": "Check receivable timing against liabilities falling due."}, "margin": {"fact": "FY2024 after-tax margin was 5.4%.", "next_check": "Check the operating costs behind the reported margin."}, "register": {"fact": "It was incorporated on 2006-05-11.", "next_check": "Verify the current register and signing authority."}}}
